title: Overdone
text: Overdone. Wish there was a separate switch for the music, it’s very loud. Didn’t realize it played different songs until covering up the speaker because couldn’t stand how loud it was for long enough to get to the next song. A bit too much “snow” for how fast it’s swirled around, can barely tell what’s in there unless you’re right up to it. It’s okay but I probably wouldn’t buy again. I’m a much bigger fan of the crank globes that time out. I do like that it lights up with color changes and spins the snow though.
